segments.en: Hello everyone, welcome back to another great lesson here with us at EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到 Englishpod 的另一个精彩课程。

segments.en: And today we're going to be in one of my favorite sporting events, which is?
segments.zh: 今天我们将参加我最喜欢的体育赛事之一，哪个是？

segments.en: So yeah, we're going to be talking about racing, specifically F1, which is a very popular sport all over the world.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，我们将谈论赛车，特别是 F1，这是一项在世界各地非常流行的运动。

segments.en: Yeah, I think maybe it's like number two in popularity after soccer.
segments.zh: 是的，我想这可能就像足球后的第二名。

segments.en: I have no numbers to back that up though.
segments.zh: 不过，我没有数字来支持这一点。

segments.en: Well they do travel everywhere, they have races all over the world and just people love it.
segments.zh: 好吧，他们确实到处旅行，他们在世界各地都有种族，只是人们喜欢它。

segments.en: Well, it is kind of a cool thing.
segments.zh: 嗯，这是一件很酷的事情。

segments.en: Well, going 300 kilometers per hour in a car is pretty cool.
segments.zh: 好吧，在车里每小时行驶 300 公里非常酷。

segments.en: Alright, so let's not delay this any longer.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们不要再拖延这个了。

segments.en: Let's listen to our dialogue for the first time.
segments.zh: 让我们第一次听我们的对话。

segments.en: Welcome back racing fans, my name is Rick Fields and as always I'm joined by my partner in crime, Bob Copeland.
segments.zh: 欢迎回来，各位赛车迷。我是瑞克·菲尔兹，和往常一样，老搭档鲍勃·科普兰也在这里。

segments.en: We're in the last stretch of this very exciting race and Kimi Raikonen is leading the pack with only four laps to go.
segments.zh: 精彩的比赛进入最后阶段，只剩四圈，基米·莱科宁目前领跑。

segments.en: They're heading to turn three and Lewis Hamilton tries to pass Raikonen.
segments.zh: 车手们驶向三号弯，刘易斯·汉密尔顿试图超越莱科宁。

segments.en: It's a close one and oh no, Hamilton hits the wall.
segments.zh: 贴得很近，哎呀，汉密尔顿撞上护墙了！

segments.en: He came in too fast, jammed on the brakes and spun out.
segments.zh: 他进弯太快，猛踩刹车后打滑冲出了赛道。

segments.en: We have a yellow flag and the pace car is making its way onto the track.
segments.zh: 赛道亮起黄旗，安全车正驶上赛道。

segments.en: The cleanup crew is towing the heavily damaged car and the green flag drops.
segments.zh: 工作人员正在拖走严重受损的赛车；绿旗挥下，比赛恢复！

segments.en: Raikonen is still in the lead with only two laps to go.
segments.zh: 莱科宁仍然处于领先地位，只剩下两圈了。

segments.en: Smoke is coming out of his car.
He seems to be having engine trouble.
segments.zh: 他似乎遇到了发动机问题。

segments.en: He makes his way under the pit and Fernando Alonso takes the lead.
segments.zh: 莱科宁驶入维修区，费尔南多·阿隆索超到第一。

segments.en: How unlucky for Raikonen and this race is over, ladies and gentlemen.
segments.zh: 莱科宁真倒霉，女士们先生们，这场比赛已经结束了。

segments.en: I always love a good crash when it comes to car races.
segments.zh: 在赛车方面，我总是喜欢一个好的碰撞。

segments.en: I think many people go to races expecting to see a crash.
segments.zh: 我想很多人去参加比赛，期待看到车祸。

segments.en: They don't want to see people getting hurt.
segments.zh: 他们不想看到人们受到伤害。

segments.en: No, but a little bit of...
The emotion of just car crashes and stuff.
Yeah, a little explosion here and there.
segments.zh: 是的，这里和那里有点爆炸。

segments.en: So, now we saw some really exciting language related to racing.
segments.zh: 所以，现在我们看到了一些与赛车相关的非常令人兴奋的语言。

segments.en: So why don't we look at that now in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不现在在语言外卖中看一下。

segments.en: Alright, so we were talking about that crash and I think what led to the crash was the driver jammed on the brakes.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们在谈论那次事故，我认为导致坠机的是司机卡在刹车上。

segments.en: Now, if I jam on the brakes...
segments.zh: 现在，如果我在刹车上卡住了...

segments.en: You push the brakes really, really hard and really quickly and really suddenly.
segments.zh: 你真的非常非常努力，真的很快，真的很突然。

segments.en: So you jam on the brakes and you stop very quickly.
segments.zh: 所以你在刹车上卡住了，你很快就停了。

segments.en: So Lewis Hamilton jammed on the brakes and consequently spun out.
segments.zh: 因此，刘易斯·汉密尔顿（Lewis Hamilton）卡在了刹车上，因此转了出去。

segments.en: In the present, it would be spin out.
So, imagine yourselves driving your car on a very wet road.
segments.zh: 所以，想象一下自己在一条非常潮湿的道路上驾驶你的车。

segments.en: And then you jam on the brakes.
So then the car, you kind of lose control of the car and it starts to spin.
segments.zh: 那么汽车，你就失去了对汽车的控制，它开始旋转。

segments.en: That would be to spin out.
This has actually happened to me more than once.
segments.zh: 这实际上不止一次发生在我身上。

segments.en: Now, in racing, you always see this really cool car come out and be ahead of everyone when there's an accident.
segments.zh: 现在，在赛车中，你总是看到这辆非常酷的车出来，在发生事故时领先于所有人。

segments.en: Now, why is it called the pace car?
segments.zh: 现在，为什么它被称为 Pace Car？

segments.en: So, the car spun out and no other car can pass it.
segments.zh: 于是，车子转了出来，没有其他车能通过它。

segments.en: Everyone must go at the same speed.
segments.zh: 每个人都必须以同样的速度前进。

segments.en: So, after there's an accident, the cleanup crew must come out.
segments.zh: 所以，发生事故后，清理人员必须出来。

segments.en: So, crew, this is an interesting word.
segments.zh: 所以，船员，这是一个有趣的词。

segments.en: When we talk about a crew, we talk about a group of people who work together.
segments.zh: 当我们谈论一个船员时，我们谈论一群一起工作的人。

segments.en: But, for example, in an office, can I have a crew?
segments.zh: 但是，例如，在办公室里，我可以有一个工作人员吗？

segments.en: People work together and they use their hands to work.
segments.zh: 人们一起工作，他们用手工作。

segments.en: So, I can say, for example, a construction crew.
segments.zh: 所以，我可以说，例如，一个施工人员。

segments.en: Or maybe the ground crew at the airport.
segments.zh: 或者也许是机场的地勤人员。

segments.en: Now, they came out to take that car away, that broken or damaged vehicle.
segments.zh: 现在，他们出来把那辆车拿走了，那辆破损或受损的车辆。

segments.en: So, what does it mean when you tow something or you tow a car?
segments.zh: 那么，当您牵引某物或拖车时，这意味着什么？

segments.en: So, if you're a truck, that might pull a car behind you.
segments.zh: 所以，如果你是一辆卡车，那可能会把车拉到你身后。

segments.en: Now, this happens commonly if you park your vehicle where you are not supposed to.
segments.zh: 现在，如果您将车辆停在不应该的地方，这种情况通常会发生。

segments.en: And your car will get towed.
So, we saw five really great words related to racing.
segments.zh: 所以，我们看到了与赛车相关的五个非常棒的词。

segments.en: And now, why don't we listen to our dialogue again and then we'll look at some other interesting phrases.
segments.zh: 现在，我们为什么不再听一次我们的对话，然后我们会看看其他一些有趣的短语。
我的名字是瑞克菲尔兹。

segments.en: And as always, I'm joined by my partner in crime, Bob Copeland.
segments.zh: 和往常一样，我的犯罪伙伴鲍勃·科普兰也加入了我的行列。

segments.en: We're in the last stretch of this very exciting race.
segments.zh: 我们正处于这场非常激动人心的比赛的最后阶段。

segments.en: And Kimi Raikonen is leading the pack with only four laps to go.
segments.zh: Kimi Raikonen 仅剩四圈就领先。

segments.en: They are heading to turn three and Lewis Hamilton tries to pass Raikonen.
segments.zh: 他们将进入第三回合，刘易斯·汉密尔顿试图超越莱科宁。

segments.en: It's a close one and oh no, Hamilton hits the wall.
segments.zh: 贴得很近，哎呀，汉密尔顿撞上护墙了！

segments.en: He came in too fast, jammed on the brakes and spun out.
segments.zh: 他进弯太快，猛踩刹车后打滑冲出了赛道。

segments.en: We have a yellow flag and the pace car is making its way onto the track.
segments.zh: 赛道亮起黄旗，安全车正驶上赛道。

segments.en: The cleanup crew is towing the heavily damaged car and the green flag drops.
segments.zh: 工作人员正在拖走严重受损的赛车；绿旗挥下，比赛恢复！

segments.en: Raikonen is still in the lead with only two laps to go.
segments.zh: 莱科宁仍然处于领先地位，只剩下两圈了。

segments.en: Smoke is coming out of his car.
He seems to be having engine trouble.
segments.zh: 他似乎遇到了发动机问题。

segments.en: He makes his way into the pit and Fernando Alonso takes the lead.
segments.zh: 他进入了坑，费尔南多·阿隆索带头。
对莱科宁来说是多么不幸。

segments.en: And this race is over, ladies and gentlemen.
segments.zh: 女士们，先生们，这场比赛结束了。

segments.en: So now we're back and I think it's time for us to take a look at some phrases in FluencyBuilder.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们回来了，我认为是时候让我们看看 FluencyBuilder 中的一些短语了。

segments.en: Well, even though we're talking about F1 racing, a lot of the language can be used in many different situations.
segments.zh: 好吧，即使我们在谈论 F1 赛车，很多语言都可以在许多不同的情况下使用。

segments.en: So let's look at some of those phrases now.
segments.zh: 所以让我们现在看看其中的一些短语。

segments.en: When Rick Fields introduced his co-host, he said, my partner in crime.
segments.zh: 他说，当 Rick Fields 介绍他的共同主持人时，我的犯罪伙伴。

segments.en: Now, it's not that they're actually committing a crime.
segments.zh: 现在，并不是他们真的在犯罪。

segments.en: No, they're not actually bank robbers.
segments.zh: 不，他们实际上不是银行劫匪。

segments.en: But it's a very common and friendly way of saying my good friend or my...
segments.zh: 但这是一种非常常见和友好的表达方式，我的好朋友或我的...

segments.en: The person I do everything with.
segments.zh: 和我一起做所有事情的人。

segments.en: But a co-worker who's a really, really good friend, who you spend a lot of time with.
segments.zh: 但是一个真正非常好的朋友，你花很多时间和他在一起的同事。

segments.en: So that's your partner in crime.
segments.zh: 所以那是你的犯罪伙伴。

segments.en: Now what about the next phrase?
segments.zh: 现在下一个短语怎么样？

segments.en: Okay, before we explain this word, let's listen to some examples and then we'll come back and talk about it.
segments.zh: 好的，在我们解释这个词之前，让我们听一些例子，然后我们会回来谈论它。

segments.en: We are finally in the last stretch of a very long week.
segments.zh: 我们终于进入了漫长的一周的最后一段。

segments.en: I can't wait to go home.
He's in the last stretch of his college years and soon he'll graduate.
segments.zh: 他正处于大学的最后阶段，很快他就会毕业。

segments.en: Okay, so I understand that to mean like the final length of time.
segments.zh: 好的，所以我理解这意味着最终时间长度。

segments.en: The last or final moments before an ending.
segments.zh: 结束前的最后或最后时刻。

segments.en: All right, so the last stretch.
Now when you're on the last stretch, you just have a few minutes to go.
segments.zh: 现在，当您处于最后阶段时，您只有几分钟的时间。

segments.en: Now this preposition to and the verb go is very easy, right?
segments.zh: 现在这个介词和动词go很容易，对吧？

segments.en: But if you say five minutes to go, what does that mean?
segments.zh: 但如果你说还有五分钟，那是什么意思？

segments.en: It doesn't mean it's five minutes to actually leave, right?
segments.zh: 这并不意味着实际离开需要五分钟，对吧？

segments.en: It means you must complete five minutes before you can be finished.
segments.zh: 这意味着您必须完成五分钟才能完成。

segments.en: I have five days to go before I go on vacation.
segments.zh: 我还有五天的时间去度假。

segments.en: So it's not about you actually going on the vacation, it's about you passing those five days.
segments.zh: 所以这不是关于你实际去度假，而是关于你度过这五天。

segments.en: Can you give us another example?
segments.zh: 你能给我们再举一个例子吗？

segments.en: How about we have 45 minutes to go before the end of the day.
segments.zh: 在一天结束前还有 45 分钟的时间怎么样。

segments.en: Now let's take a look at our last phrase.
segments.zh: 现在让我们来看看我们的最后一句话。

segments.en: Another interesting phrase made up of simple words.
segments.zh: 另一个由简单单词组成的有趣短语。

segments.en: So let's listen to some examples to help us understand it.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听一些例子来帮助我们理解它。

segments.en: The teacher almost caught me cheating.
segments.zh: 老师差点发现我出轨了。

segments.en: The sun is up and the tide and the game is almost over.
segments.zh: 太阳升起，潮汐，游戏快结束了。

segments.en: My girlfriend almost found the presents I hid under the bed.
segments.zh: 我的女朋友几乎找到了我藏在床底下的礼物。

segments.en: So a close one, it means?
A situation that is almost dangerous but wasn't.
segments.zh: 一种几乎危险但不是的情况。

segments.en: I think we can take a lot from this and apply it outside of F1, right?
segments.zh: 我认为我们可以从中获取很多并在 F1 之外应用它，对吧？

segments.en: So let's listen to the dialogue for the last time and then we'll come back and talk about this great sport.
segments.zh: 所以让我们最后一次听对话，然后我们会回来谈论这项伟大的运动。

segments.en: My name is Rick Fields and as always I'm joined by my partner in crime, Bob Copeland.
segments.zh: 我的名字是 Rick Fields，我的犯罪伙伴 Bob Copeland 一如既往地加入了我的行列。

segments.en: We're in the last stretch of this very exciting race and Kimi Raikkonen is leading the pack with only four laps to go.
segments.zh: 我们正处于这场非常激动人心的比赛的最后阶段，Kimi Raikkonen 仅剩 4 圈就领先。

segments.en: They're heading to turn three and Lewis Hamilton tries to pass Raikkonen.
segments.zh: 他们将前往第三回合，刘易斯·汉密尔顿试图超越莱科宁。

segments.en: It's a close one and oh no, Hamilton hits the wall.
segments.zh: 贴得很近，哎呀，汉密尔顿撞上护墙了！

segments.en: He came in too fast, jammed on the brakes and spun out.
segments.zh: 他进弯太快，猛踩刹车后打滑冲出了赛道。

segments.en: We have yellow flag and the pace car is making its way into the track.
segments.zh: 我们有黄旗，Pace Car 正在进入赛道。

segments.en: The cleanup crew is towing the heavily damaged car and the green flag drops.
segments.zh: 工作人员正在拖走严重受损的赛车；绿旗挥下，比赛恢复！

segments.en: Raikkonen is still in the lead with only two laps to go.
segments.zh: 莱科宁仍然处于领先地位，只剩下两圈了。

segments.en: Smoke is coming out of his car.
He seems to be having engine trouble.
segments.zh: 他似乎遇到了发动机问题。

segments.en: He makes his way under the pit and Fernando Alonso takes the lead.
segments.zh: 莱科宁驶入维修区，费尔南多·阿隆索超到第一。

segments.en: Now unlucky for Raikkonen and this race is over ladies and gentlemen.
segments.zh: 现在对莱科宁来说不幸，这场比赛结束了女士们先生们。
好吧，所以 F1 赛车。

segments.en: You know, cars that drive fast, that's pretty interesting.
segments.zh: 你知道，开得快的汽车，这很有趣。

segments.en: Well for some people it isn't, right, like why do I want to go to a race and just see fast cars?
segments.zh: 好吧，对于某些人来说，这不是，对，比如我为什么要参加比赛，只看快车？

segments.en: Okay, I would never go to a race but I think it's, I would maybe watch the highlights on TV.
segments.zh: 好吧，我永远不会去参加比赛，但我认为是的，我可能会在电视上观看精彩片段。

segments.en: Well actually this year it's really exciting because again we're going to have a night race, I think it's in Malaysia or somewhere in Asia that they're going to race at night.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上今年真的很令人兴奋，因为我们再次将进行夜间比赛，我认为他们将在马来西亚或亚洲的某个地方参加比赛。

segments.en: Well it's like harder to see and you're going really fast, imagine.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就像更难看到，而且你的速度非常快，想象一下。

segments.en: So I hear you're going to the F1 this year.
segments.zh: 所以我听说你今年要去F1。

segments.en: Yes, this year I'm going to go to the Shanghai circuit to watch the F1 race so I'm really excited about that.
segments.zh: 是的，今年我要去上海巡回赛看 F1 比赛，所以我真的很兴奋。

segments.en: I haven't ever been to one so it should be fun.
segments.zh: 我从来没有去过一个，所以它应该很有趣。

segments.en: Alright well I hope you get to see some interesting things like car crashes and pace cars.
segments.zh: 好吧，我希望你能看到一些有趣的东西，比如车祸和步伐汽车。

segments.en: What about you guys, our listeners?
Have you ever been to an F1 race?
Exactly, send us your questions and comments and also your stories.
segments.zh: 确切地说，将您的问题和评论以及您的故事发送给我们。

segments.en: I think we have listeners from all over the world.
segments.zh: 我想我们有来自世界各地的听众。

segments.en: We have a lot of listeners in Brazil and I know that there is a Grand Prix there so tell us how did it go?
segments.zh: 我们在巴西有很多听众，我知道那里有一个大奖赛，所以告诉我们进展如何？

segments.en: You can visit us at EnglishPod.com where Marco and I are around to answer your questions.
segments.zh: 您可以访问我们的 englishpod.com 访问我们，Marco 和我在附近回答您的问题。

segments.en: Alright, maybe our users know which one is the Canadian.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许我们的用户知道哪一种是加拿大人。

segments.en: So we'll see you guys there.
